title: Prehistoric Wilds
description: Hunt prehistoric beasts across a lush volcanic island, dodge telegraphed attacks, harvest resources, craft primitive gear, build your camp, and relight the ancient signal tower.

defaultCaptions.x: Read the tells, roll through the stomp, punish the recovery. Prehistoric Wilds is a stylized browser 3D hunting and crafting expedition.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Prehistoric Wilds: explore a volcanic island, hunt original creatures and apex beasts, craft stronger gear, and relight your camp's signal tower. Plays directly in your browser.
defaultCaptions.reddit: I created Prehistoric Wilds, a browser 3D hunting and crafting action expedition with telegraphed combat, weapon classes, tracking, and camp progression.
defaultCaptions.discord: Prehistoric Wilds: a stylized 3D browser hunt. Dodge, punish, carve, craft, and light the signal tower.
